builds.title: Brownie household keeper, level 1
builds.languages: Fairy, Thyatian, Halfling, Lawful. Can communicate with animals.
builds.speed: 120 ft. per exploration turn, 40 ft. per encounter round.
traits: Lawful. Natural AC 9 with Dexterity improving it by 1. THAC0 17 on the 3 HD monster row. Halfling level 3 saves 8/9/10/13/12.
Roll 1d6 per side for initiative. Saves are d20 targets in order: death ray or poison, wands, paralysis or stone, breath, rod or staff or spell.
Hob has no restricted magic item on hand. If he acquires one, Table 9 at level 1 succeeds on 01–05, fails on 06–89, backfires on 90–99 and yields an unusual result on 00.
actions: Belt dagger. One melee roll on the 3 HD monster row, dealing 1d4 on a hit.
Fairy invisibility at will. Hob can hide from ordinary mortal sight. Fairies and people with second sight can still see him.
builds.tactics: Slip out of sight and use the scullery door. Draw the dagger only if cornered.

builds.title: Unattached dryad, level 1
builds.languages: Dryad, Thyatian, Elvish, Fairy, Treant, Neutral. Can communicate with plants.
builds.speed: 120 ft. per exploration turn, 40 ft. per encounter round.
traits: Neutral. Unarmored, with natural AC 7. THAC0 18 on the 2 HD monster row. Cleric level 1 saves 11/12/14/16/15, with +1 on applicable saves against spells from Wisdom.
Roll 1d6 per side for initiative. Saves are d20 targets in order: death ray or poison, wands, paralysis or stone, breath, rod or staff or spell.
Linden has no soul-tree. Her class grants its first druid spell at level 2.
actions: Dagger. One melee roll on the 2 HD monster row, dealing 1d4 on a hit.

Charm person, three times per day. One eligible living humanoid within 120 ft. saves vs. spells or treats Linden as a close friend. Repeat the save after a day at Intelligence 13–18, a week at 9–12 or a month at 3–8. Linden attacking the target ends the charm.
builds.tactics: Ask the plants who crossed the glade. Charm a lookout if the path needs to be cleared without a fight.

builds.title: Faun piper, level 5
builds.languages: Dryad, Thyatian, Chaotic. Can communicate with animals.
builds.speed: 150 ft. per exploration turn, 50 ft. per encounter round.
traits: Chaotic. Natural AC 8, improved by 1 through Dexterity. Base THAC0 14 on the 6 HD monster row. Thief level 5 saves 11/12/11/14/13.
Roll 1d6 per side for initiative. Saves are d20 targets in order: death ray or poison, wands, paralysis or stone, breath, rod or staff or spell.
actions: Short sword. One melee attack with +1 to the roll for Strength, 1d6+1 damage on a hit.

Play the shepherd’s pipes. After a full uninterrupted round, draw out an impulse already present in a listener and try to make it dominate their behavior. The spell save is rolled at +4 in round 1, +3 in round 2 and one point lower each round to −4 in round 9 and later. Deafness or magical silence blocks the effect. Starting in round 5 Fen saves each round or succumbs to the same impulse. Any interruption resets progress.
builds.tactics: Play on doubt or the urge to flee from cover. Break off before round five if nothing has changed.

builds.title: Hsiao scholar and priest, level 1
builds.difficulty: Level 1 at 8,000 XP, 5 HD. Two first-circle and two second-circle spells.
builds.languages: Hsiao, Thyatian, Centaur, Dryad, Elvish, Fairy, Treant, Lawful. Can communicate with birds.
builds.speed: Ground 90 ft. per exploration turn, 30 ft. per encounter round. Flight 210 ft. per exploration turn, 70 ft. per encounter round, while carrying at most 20 cn.
traits: Lawful. Natural AC 5 and THAC0 15 on the 5 HD monster row. Cleric level 1 saves 11/12/14/16/15, with +1 on applicable saves against spells from Wisdom.
Roll 1d6 per side for initiative. Saves are d20 targets in order: death ray or poison, wands, paralysis or stone, breath, rod or staff or spell.
Cleric spellcasting at effective level 5. Cast one prepared spell in the magic phase after declaring it before initiative.
actions: Claw, claw, bite. Three separate attacks on the 5 HD monster row, for 1d6, 1d6 and 1d4 damage.

Cure light wounds, prepared once. Touch a living creature to restore 1d6+1 HP or remove paralysis. Protection from evil, prepared once. Self only for 12 turns. Gain +1 to saves, impose −1 on incoming attack rolls and ward off contact from enchanted creatures until Sedge attacks one.

Bless, prepared once. Allies outside melee in a 20-ft. square within 60 ft. get +1 morale, attack and damage for six turns. Resist fire, prepared once. One living creature within 30 ft. ignores ordinary fire for two turns, gets +2 to saves against magical fire and subtracts 1 point per die of magical fire damage, minimum 1 per die.
builds.tactics: Bless allies before melee and use elevation to stay clear. Save the healing spell for an injured companion.

builds.title: Leprechaun cobbler, mature normal tier
builds.difficulty: Mature normal monster tier at 0 XP. ¼ HD, no spell slots yet.
builds.languages: Fairy, Thyatian, Elvish, Gnome, Neutral. Can communicate with animals.
builds.speed: 60 ft. per exploration turn, 20 ft. per encounter round, with at most 20 cn.
traits: Neutral. Base AC 9 improved by 1 through Dexterity. THAC0 19 on the up-to-1-HD monster row. Elf level 1 saves 12/13/13/15/15.
Roll 1d6 per side for initiative. Saves are d20 targets in order: death ray or poison, wands, paralysis or stone, breath, rod or staff or spell.
actions: Miniature sword. One melee roll on the up-to-1-HD monster row, dealing 1d3 on a hit.
Fairy invisibility at will. A mortal who sees Niall must look away before Niall can vanish from that mortal’s sight. Fairies and people with second sight can still see him.
builds.tactics: Turn a watcher’s attention to something else, vanish and leave through a narrow gap.

concepts.name: Hob Reedstitch
concepts.speciesPublication: Tall Tales of the Wee Folk (PC1, 1989)
concepts.role: Night keeper for an isolated inn.
concepts.motive: Keep the family’s winter stores from being impounded.
concepts.hook: Hob leaves a clean flour handprint on the sack containing a counterfeit seal.

concepts.name: Linden Veil
concepts.speciesPublication: Tall Tales of the Wee Folk (PC1, 1989)
concepts.role: Travelling caretaker working to restore a cleared orchard.
concepts.motive: Recover a graft from the last living tree of an old variety.
concepts.hook: Linden offers a safe route across the floodplain if the party brings back a living cutting.

concepts.name: Fen Alderpipe
concepts.speciesPublication: Tall Tales of the Wee Folk (PC1, 1989)
concepts.role: Piper who guides flocks between seasonal pastures.
concepts.motive: Find out who cut the bridge ropes before the next crossing.
concepts.hook: Fen asks the party to follow the trail his missing flock left in the alder thicket.

concepts.name: Sedge of the Quiet Branch
concepts.speciesPublication: Tall Tales of the Wee Folk (PC1, 1989)
concepts.role: Keeper of a woodland flight-route archive.
concepts.motive: Recover a missing folio before the next migration.
concepts.hook: A jay carried the folio’s marker to a collapsed rookery above a stream.

concepts.name: Niall Quickgold
concepts.speciesPublication: Tall Tales of the Wee Folk (PC1, 1989)
concepts.role: Cobbler who mends lost shoes for travellers.
concepts.motive: Recover a stolen shoe last before market day.
concepts.hook: Niall heard the thief trade the last for a key at a roadside stall.
